title: Defeat at Ai and the Valley of Achor

named.name: Ai
named.label: below
named.note: et-Tell, the usual identification. See the Joshua 8 map for the other proposals.

named.name: Shebarim
named.label: right
named.note: "The quarries" or "the breaks" (7:5): the rout ran down the slope from Ai. OpenBible places it with low confidence on the cliffs of Wadi Makkuk.

named.name: Valley of Achor
named.label: below
named.note: "Valley of Trouble" (7:26), on Judah’s border (15:7). Often placed at el-Buqei’a in the Judean desert; the identification is uncertain.

moves.text: Spies go up from Jericho to Ai
About 3,000 men go up against Ai
Routed from the gate to Shebarim, down the descent
Achan and all he had are taken to the Valley of Achor

symbols.key: A great heap of stones "to this day"

p: About the routes. Places are located from OpenBible.info. The lines between them are reconstructions drawn for teaching, not paths the text describes.
